[attribute-notation]
=== `@notation` Notation

Indicates that the content of the associated element will be coded in one of the named notations.

#### Usage/Remarks
Because the use of characters such as “`<`” and “`&`” can cause problems when TeX (or LaTeX) is embedded within XML, it is Best Practice to surround all TeX and LaTeX by a `CDATA` section.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-tex-math,`<tex-math>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| LaTeX| The content of the associated element will be in LaTeX.
| TEX| The content of the associated element will be in TeX.
| TeX| The content of the associated element will be in TeX.
| tex| The content of the associated element will be in TeX.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
